notes: DTU tuition fee waiver is a university-wide, merit-based award for non-EU/EEA MSc applicants, decided in parallel with admissions by the university based on GPA, bachelor's university ranking, and research/work experience - no separate department or supervisor is attached. Official page (https://www.dtu.dk/english/education/graduate/fees-and-funding/tuition_fee_waivers) names no professor or programme director; only admissions contacts are given (photobook/dtu.dk phonebook, no published supervisor email). Not a research-supervision scheme, so no supervising professor exists or is published.

The official_source_url in the batch (https://www.cbs.dk/study-programmes/master-programmes/double-degree) is CBS's Double Degree page, which does not describe a 'Danish Government Scholarship'; CBS's international full-degree students pages (fetched at cbs.dk/en/uddannelser/international-students/international-full-degree-students and /en/study-programmes/international-students) show no Danish Government Scholarship and no scholarship attached to any faculty member. CBS master's funding, where mentioned, is administered centrally by CBS Admissions (programme contact pages), not by individual professors. No named professor with an institutional profile/email could be tied to this scholarship.

University of Copenhagen Danish Government Scholarship is a university-wide tuition waiver/grant: 'All non-EU/EEA applicants offered admission will automatically be considered for the scholarship; you do not submit an individual application for the scholarship.' Faculty-specific conditions on the official page (https://www.ku.dk/studies/admission/scholarships-for-full-degree-students) describe faculty allocations only; no professor, supervisor, or admissions committee member is named on the page, and no institutional email for any faculty member is published there. Not a research-supervision scheme.

Aarhus University Danish state scholarship is a university-wide tuition waiver granted automatically with admission (assessed with the admission application, no separate application), so no department or supervising professor is attached. The official batch URL (https://masters.au.dk/scholarships-and-grants) returned repeated transport errors from this environment and could not be fetched; adjacent official Aarhus pages (international.au.dk/education and au.dk/en/education) confirm only central administration of master's tuition/scholarship matters. No named professor or published faculty email is tied to this scholarship.

SDU Danish Government Scholarship is restricted to seven specific programmes (MSc Electronics/Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics at Sønderborg; BSc Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Interactive Technology Engineering, Software Engineering at Vejle). The official scholarship page (https://www.sdu.dk/en/uddannelse/fees_and_funding/scholarships) selects candidates via uniTEST/interview with unnamed 'key people from the study programme' and directs all enquiries to the SDU admissions office; no professor, programme director, or supervisor is named on the scholarship page. The MSc Mechatronics programme page (https://www.sdu.dk/en/uddannelse/kandidat/mechatronics) and its contact page name no staff (only admissions office phone and the generic Engineeringsonderborg@tek.sdu.dk mailbox), so no individual faculty member with evidence could be recorded.

BI Presidential Scholarship is awarded across all master's programmes at BI's Oslo and Bergen campuses on academic merit, decided by the institution based on the uploaded CV/application letter in the admissions portal. Official page (https://www.bi.no/en/programmes-and-individual-courses/scholarships/bi-presidential-scholarships) names no professor, programme director, or supervisor; the only published contact is the general mailbox info@bi.no. Not a research-supervision scheme.

Master International Scholarship - Bergen is a merit-based tuition scholarship for any MSc programme at BI's Bergen campus, awarded centrally by BI on academic record with distribution 'across MSc programmes'. Official page (https://www.bi.no/en/programmes-and-individual-courses/scholarships/master-of-science-international-scholarship--bergen) names no professor, programme director, or supervisor and publishes no faculty contact email (only the generic info@bi.no). Not a research-supervision scheme.
